status_summary: No change from Federal Credit Reform Act accounting to fair-value accounting was found. Public Law 119-21, signed on 2025-07-04, added a program earnings test for Direct Loan eligibility rather than a requirement that institutions share loan losses. A House reconciliation proposal that would have required colleges to reimburse a share of unpaid loans was reported in June 2025, and the Senate committee text replaced it with an earnings-based metric. The Department's final earnings rule was published on 2026-07-01 (91 FR 40136).

timeline.event: Public Law 119-21 was signed; its section 84001 created a program-level earnings test for Direct Loan eligibility, and the Congressional Research Service summary of its Higher Education Act amendments does not mention institutional risk sharing or fair-value accounting.

The Department of Education published a final rule (91 FR 40136) implementing the earnings provisions of Public Law 119-21 through an earnings premium test; it is not a risk-sharing or fair-value measure.

title: Fair-value accounting for federal student loans and institutional risk sharing
uncertainties: The House risk-sharing proposal is described in a public-radio report and its House vote and date were not confirmed from a primary source, so it is not entered as a timeline event. The CRS text read was truncated, so risk sharing in omitted sections is not excluded, though a community college trustees association comparison and the radio report indicate the Senate replaced it. The Congressional Budget Office publishes credit estimates including fair-value measures as part of its own analysis; that is not a government accounting change and was not used as an event. No OMB, Treasury or Department change to loan accounting was found in the FY2027 budget summary text read. Standalone bills on risk sharing in the 119th Congress were searched (one search) and none were confirmed. The reviewer re-read the CRS report, which mentions neither risk sharing nor fair-value accounting in the portion read, and ran no searches for this record. c11-08 lists this element as unchecked; this record owns it.
